news.body: The Falcons' D/ST logged two sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing 24 points in Monday's win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Falcons D/ST allows 24 points Monday
news.impact: Atlanta's offense looked phenomenal on Monday night, but their defense wasn't as dominant. They allowed 24 points over the course of the night and weren't able to log many game-altering plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started in a tough matchup against the Ravens next week.

news.body: The Atlanta Falcons D/ST had themselves a nice defensive showing in a game they won 35-14, getting a sack and an interception along the way.
news.head: Atlanta Falcons D/ST holds Packers to 14 points
news.impact: While they didn't get many turnovers or sacks, they simply made it tough for the Packers to move the balll, forcing many punts throughout the night. The Packers still found paydirt with Matthew Golden and Christian Watson, but it was not nearly enough to turn things around. The Falcons will try to limit the Saints offense next time out.

news.body: The Atlanta Falcons D/ST managed two sacks but not much else in their 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Atlanta Falcons D/ST overrun in loss to Panthers
news.impact: The Falcons' defense was completely outclassed by the Panthers' offense and was largely powerless to stop them. They're a tough unit to stream moving forward.

news.body: The Falcons D/ST allowed 20 points while picking up two sacks and forcing a turnover in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
news.head: Falcons D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 1
news.impact: Atlanta's defense turned in a solid effort, limiting the Steelers to 264 yards of total offense in the loss. They recovered a Jaylen Warren fumble in the game, while Za'Darius Smith notched both of the team's sacks. The Falcons will now take on a Panthers defense that allowed 59 points to the Bears in Week 1.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 222 passing yards, 85 rushing yards, and 18 points in a win over the Titans.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 18 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. The Titans' offense was finally able to start breaking through in the second half, but the game appeared well in hand at that point. The Ravens will travel to Atlanta in Week 5.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 31 points while picking up one sack and forcing one turnover in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: Baltimore's defense struggled to keep up with an excellent Dallas offense in this high-scoring matchup. They managed to recover one fumble while getting a sack from Roquan Smith in the win. They will be a top fantasy option in Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 24 pints, 252 yards passing, and 65 rushing yards in the loss to the Saints.
news.head: Ravens D/ST struggles in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied three sacks but failed to force a turnover in the loss. The Ravens will need to get some of the issues with the pass defense together before taking on Dak Prescott and the Cowboys in Week 3.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST recorded two sacks, one fumble recovery, and one interception in a Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Ravens D/ST stifles Colts in Week 1 win
news.impact: The defense stood tall in the season opener for first-year head coach Jesse Minter, allowing less than 275 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of a favorable Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: The Bengals' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 22 points in Sunday's loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Bengals D/ST logs four sacks Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's defense was able to put the pressure on QB Trevor Lawrence and the Jaguars on Sunday, but they weren't able to bring things home and ended up losing in Week 4. This unit has looked much improved so far this season and can safely be started in an easy matchup against the Dolphins next week.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 30 points, 292 passing yards, and 138 rushing yards in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Bengals D/ST allows 30 points in Week 3 loss
news.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in loss Sunday. They struggled to stop Jaylen Warren on the ground, as he averaged 7.5 yards per carry on the day. The defense will have a tough matchup against a strong Jacksonville offense in Week 4.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed six points on 374 total yards with four sacks on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Bengals D/ST posts another strong performance Sunday
news.impact: It is the second straight strong performance to start the season for the Bengals defense. They will be on the streaming radar next week against Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers offense.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 20 points on 282 total yards with four sacks and four fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bengals D/ST forces four fumbles Sunday
news.impact: The Bengals defense forced three fumbles of Baker Mayfield alone on Sunday and one on Bucky Irving. They will face CJ Stroud and the Texans in Week 2.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 30 points on 397 total yards with two sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: Dallas was unable to contain Nico Collins in his return on Sunday. They'll take on Jalon Daniels and the Bucs on Thursday.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 34 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST struggles in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Dallas couldn’t slow down Lamar Jackson or Derrick Henry in the high-scoring loss in Rio de Janeiro. The Cowboys will look to bounce back in Week 4 in a much more favorable matchup against the Texans.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 20 points, 207 passing yards, and 182 rushing yards in the win over the Commanders.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST allows 20 points in Week 2 win
news.impact: The Cowboys' defense tallied one fumble recovery, but failed to record a sack and allowed a 5.7 yards per carry average to the running game. The Cowboys' defense will have to clean that up before taking on Derrick Henry and the Ravens in Week 3.

news.body: The Cowboys' D/ST logged two sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing 28 points in Sunday night's loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST struggles in loss Sunday
news.impact: Dallas' defense didn't look great on Sunday night. They allowed New York to put up 28 points over the course of the game, which led to a loss on the road for the Cowboys. This unit is not likely to be worth starting in most fantasy leagues moving forward.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST failed to record a sack or turnover while allowing 24 points in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
news.head: Broncos D/ST held without sack in loss Sunday
news.impact: Denver's defense held San Francisco to three points in the first half, but couldn't make enough impact plays after halftime. The Broncos' defense finished without a sack or a takeaway as the 49ers' offense scored three second-half touchdowns. That said, the Broncos get a much better matchup in Week 5 against the winless Los Angeles Chargers -- who turned the ball over three times in Sunday's loss to the Seattle Seahawks. The Broncos' defense remains a strong fantasy option in that matchup.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged four sacks, two interceptions, and a touchdown while allowing 26 points in Sunday night's win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: Denver's defense allowed the Rams' offense to move the ball on Sunday night, but they logged several big plays to help change the course of the game, including a pick-six at one crucial point. This unit is one of the NFL's finest but will have their work cut out for them in a matchup against San Francisco's red-hot offense in Week 4.

news.body: The Broncos D/ST allowed 13 points while notching two sacks and forcing one turnover in a 20-13 win over the Jaguars in Week 2.
news.head: Broncos D/ST holds Jags to 13 points
news.impact: Denver's defense made life difficult for the Jacksonville offense, holding them to just three points after halftime. It was a needed bounce-back performance after the Broncos struggled on defense against the Chiefs in Week 1. They will look to keep it going in Week 3 against the Rams.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged two sacks and one interception while allowing 31 points in Monday night's blowout loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Broncos D/ST dismal in loss Monday
news.impact: Denver's defense is supposed to be among the best in the entire NFL, but they didn't look the part on Monday night. They allowed Patrick Mahomes II to lead Kansas City to 31 points on the night, despite the fact that this was his first game back from a major injury and was missing one of his starting tackles. This unit should return to elite form at some point this season, but they have a rocky schedule coming up for the next 4-6 weeks and should not be considered an elite fantasy option at the position for that stretch of games.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 34 points on 399 total yards with three sacks Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: Houston had a chance to win its first game of the season with one defensive stop, but they weren't able to get it done. They'll look to bounce back against the Titans next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 19 points, 235 passing yards, and 89 rushing yards in a loss to the Colts Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 19 points in Week 3
news.impact: Houston's defense did a great job of keeping Jonathan Taylor in check, but allowed Daniel Jones to perform well enough to send the Texans to 0-3. The Texans will face Dallas in a tough matchup in Week 4.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 20 points on 267 total yards with five sacks on Sunday against the Bengals.
news.head: Texans D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
news.impact: Houston was able to get pressure on Joe Burrow all afternoon, but Ja'Marr Chase burned them for a pair of touchdowns. They will face Daniel Jones and the Colts next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 36 points on 409 yards of total offense while coming up with two sacks and no takeaways in Sunday's loss to the Bills.
news.head: Texans defense struggles to contain Bills in Week 1
news.impact: The Texans should feature a solid defensive unit this season, but they ran into a potent Bills' offense in Week 1. Powered by QB Josh Allen, the Bills shredded the Texans' pass defense, totaling 334 yards and a couple of scores through the air. Houston did come up with a couple of sacks, but Allen mostly had his way. The Texans will face another top-tier QB when Joe Burrow and the Bengals visit Houston in Week 2.

news.body: The Jaguars' D/ST logged two sacks and two interceptions while allowing just 17 points in Sunday's win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST logs two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: Jacksonville's defense had a great performance on Sunday. They held the Bengals to just 17 points over the course of the afternoon, and they were able to log several big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started for the foreseeable future, however, as they have more tough matchups coming down the pipe very soon.

news.body: The Jaguars' D/ST logged three sacks, two interceptions, and one fumble recovery while allowing just six points in Sunday's blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST stellar in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Jacksonville's defense absolutely shut down the Patriots' offense on Sunday. They allowed just six points over the course of the afternoon and were able to log a number of big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a tough matchup coming up against the Bengals next week, however, so they may not be worth starting despite their great performance this week.

news.body: The Jaguars D/ST allowed 20 points while forcing one turnover in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST allows 20 points in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Jacksonville's defense was able to intercept Bo Nix once in the contest. They got off to a fast start, holding Denver to six points over the first three quarters, but the Broncos found the end zone twice in the fourth to complete the comeback win. Jacksonville will now take on the Patriots in Week 3.

news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST shut down the Browns' offense on Sunday in the team's dominant 34-10 win. They ended the day with five sacks, a pick, and a fumble recovery.
news.head: Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST shut down hapless Browns
news.impact: It was a great day for the Jags' defense in what was expected to be an easy matchup. They're worth streaming when the matchup is right, but they could be in for tough sledding against Denver next week.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 20 points in Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 20 points Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' had a decent performance in Week 4, but they weren't able to log any turnovers, which hurt their final fantasy score. This is a strong unit but shouldn't be started in next week's tough matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 24 points in Sunday night's loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Rams D/ST underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense was underwhelming on Sunday night. They weren't able to log many big plays over the course of the night, and they allowed Denver's offense to score 24 points in primetime. This unit has a tough schedule coming up, which makes it hard to get excited for them from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two sacks and an interception while allowing just six points in Monday night's blowout win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense looked good on Monday night. They held the Giants' offense to just six points on the night, but that was also aided by the multiple key injuries that New York suffered over the course of the night. This unit can be started in a matchup against the Broncos next week, although that is by no means an easy game for them.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams' D/ST was completely destroyed by the 49ers' offense, and it didn't help that the Rams' offense was equally outmatched, making the final result all the more stark.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST run over by 49ers
news.impact: The Rams still have plenty of star talent on this side of the ball, so don't overreact to one week of football. They should be just fine as the season rolls along once they find their footing.

news.body: The Vikings' D/ST logged two sacks and a fumble recovery while allowing ten points in Sunday's win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Vikings D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Minnesota's defense capitalized on a good matchup on Sunday. They logged a few big plays to help out their offense and held Miami to just ten points over the course of the game. This unit is one of the NFL's finest and should continue to be started in most matchups moving forward.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 16 points on 243 total yards with six sacks and two interceptions on Sunday against the Bucs.
news.head: Vikings D/ST dominates in win Sunday
news.impact: The Vikings D/ST also scored a touchdown on a punt return. Minnesota needed its defense to come through as the offense struggled for most of the afternoon. They will be a top play next week against the Dolphins.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST registered four sacks while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
news.head: Vikings D/ST disruptive in Week 2
news.impact: The unit was able to stand tall against a Chicago ground attack, holding both D’Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai to less than 50 yards rushing each. The defense will look to take advantage of a turnover-prone Tampa Bay Buccaneers offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 22 points on 419 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Packers.
news.head: Vikings D/ST picks it up late Sunday
news.impact: Minnesota struggled in the first half defensively, but limited Green Bay to just three points in the second half where they out-scored the Packers 29-3. They'll be tough to trust next week against the Bears.

news.body: The Eagles' D/ST logged two interceptions and one sack while allowing 24 points in Sunday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Eagles D/ST logs two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense had an up-and-down game on Sunday. They logged two interceptions and didn't allow Matthew Stafford to score a single touchdown through the air, but they allowed three on the ground and allowed Los Angeles to put up 24 points en route to a win on the road. This unit should only be started in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.head: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3
news.impact: It was a poor performance by the Eagles on Monday night as they couldn't stop Case Keenum from carving them up. Keenum hadn't appeared in a regular-season game since 2023, but he tossed two touchdowns and ran for a third. The Eagles will look to regroup in a tough Week 4 matchup against the Rams.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 20 points while adding two sacks in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Eagles D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 2
news.impact: Philadelphia held Tennessee to 291 yards of total offense but they needed a last-minute TD pass from Jalen Hurts to avoid the upset. The Eagles will now head on the road to take on a Bears offense that could be without Caleb Williams (hamstring) in Week 3.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.head: Eagles D/ST registers one sack in Week 1
news.impact: The unit left plenty to be desired in the season-opening win, allowing 296 offensive yards and three touchdowns on the day. The defense will look for more disruptive results for fantasy managers against an underwhelming Tennessee Titans offense in Week 2.

news.body: The Steelers' D/ST allowed 27 points on 372 yards of total offense, recording five sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points for the second straight week
news.impact: The Steelers' defense made plenty of big plays in Thursday's loss. The unit also gave up a few too many big plays. The Steelers have allowed division rivals to put up exactly 27 points in back-to-back weeks. There's no doubting the Pittsburgh pass rush, but as a whole, the defense has been showing some holes. The Colts are next up.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 27 points, 282 passing yards, and 83 rushing yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Steelers' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery in the win Sunday. The fumble recovery came on the final drive for the Bengals to help seal the win for the Steelers. The defense will now prepare for the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 14 points, 208 passing yards, and 136 rushing yards in the 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Steelers' defense did tally an interception, a fumble recovery, and three sacks in the losing effort Sunday. The Steelers' defense will be at home against a strong Bengals' offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 13 points while scoring a touchdown, forcing two turnovers, and notching four sacks in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.head: Steelers D/ST scores TD in Week 1 win
news.impact: Pittsburgh took advantage of the Falcons being forced to start their third-string QB in Cooper Rush. T.J. Watt dominated the whole afternoon as he sealed the game with a 35-yard pick-six in the fourth quarter while also logging two sacks. The Steelers will have a tougher test in Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 23 points on 301 total yards with two interceptions, two fumble recoveries and four sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks defense was at its best early in the first half. They struggled a bit more late as the Chargers nearly overcame a 21 point deficit. The Seahawks will face Brock Purdy and the 49ers next week.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST quiet in Week 3
news.impact: The unit fell victim to a Seattle offense that turned the ball over three times in the loss. The defense will look to get back to its aggressive scheme in a Week 4 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST shut down the Arizona Cardinals offense on Sunday 31-7, racking up an interception and two sacks in the big win.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down Cardinals defense on Sunday
news.impact: Seattle's defense has allowed a grand total of 17 points over two weeks. They're shaping up to be a formidable unit so far, and are a top defense to roster for fantasy moving forward.

news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday
news.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.

news.body: The 49ers' D/ST allowed 14 points and 296 total yards while recovering one fumble in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. San Francisco did not record a sack or interception.
news.head: 49ers D/ST holds Broncos to 14 points Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco didn't make many plays from a fantasy standpoint, but the defense did its job by keeping Denver out of the end zone until the fourth quarter. A special teams fumble recovery also helped set up San Francisco's first touchdown. The lack of sacks is worth monitoring, but the 49ers remain a viable fantasy defense heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST allowed 30 points on 365 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
news.head: 49ers D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco allowed just six points in the first half before allowing 24 points in the second half. They'll face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

news.body: The 49ers' defense allowed just 13 points on 284 yards of offense while recording four sacks in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: 49ers D/ST records four sacks, stifles Dolphins offense
news.impact: For the second straight week, the 49ers' defense dominated. The unit has surrendered just 20 points in two games, holding both the Rams and Dolphins under 300 yards of total offense. The 49ers will remain a popular play in Week 3 against the Cardinals.

news.body: The San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shut down the Rams offense on Thursday, allowing just seven points in their 27-7 rout of the Super Bowl favorites.
news.head: San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shuts down Rams in win
news.impact: The Niners defensive totals were modest, with one interception and a fumble recovery, but were held without a sack. They just kept the Rams from moving the ball while not racking up much in the “counting stats” category. It’s a good showing for the team, and a date with the Dolphins is on tap. They are a great DST option this week if available.

news.body: Andy Borregales made all three of his extra point attempts in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Andy Borregales perfect in Week 4 win
news.impact: Borregales was not called upon to attempt any field goals in the win Sunday. The second-year kicker is 5-for-7 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra point attempts so far this season.

news.body: Andy Borregales went 2-for-3 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Andy Borregales misses field goal in loss Sunday
news.impact: Borregales didn't have a great game on Sunday, missing one of his three field-goal attempts in the team's blowout loss at the hands of the Jaguars. If he continues to play bad, his job could be in jeopardy at some point in the season.

news.body: Patriots K Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Andy Borregales connects on two field goals in Week 2 win
news.impact: Borregales connected on field goal attempts from 30 and 45 yards out, while missing from 47-yards out. The second-year kicker should continue to see plenty of field goal opportunities until the passing attack can find consistency.

news.body: Andy Borregales made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Andy Borregales scores four points Wednesday
news.impact: The young kicker didn't get many opportunities on Wednesday night. He converted both of his attempts, however, leaving him with at least four points on the night. He doesn't project to be a strong option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made 2-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey hit a 39 and 50-yard field goal early. He later had a 62-yarder blocked and missed a 65-yard field goal.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made three of his four field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes three FGs in Week 3
news.impact: Aubrey made field goals from 28, 38, and 23 yards out in the close loss to Baltimore. The veteran kicker has now hit six of his seven field-goal tries and added eight extra points this year. He will take on the Texans in Week 4.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey connected on all three field goal attempts and all four of his extra point attempts in a win over the Commanders.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Aubrey connected on field goals from 25, 44, and 60 yards out to help pace the Cowboys to their first win over the season. Aubrey remains one of the best kickers in the league and is a strong start against Baltimore in Week 3.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 2-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses one kick Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey didn't have a good night on Sunday night. He scored just two points in the team's loss to New York, and he even missed one of his extra-point attempts late in the game. He should bounce back and return to being a good fantasy option sometime in the near future.

news.body: Cam Little went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Cam Little scores ten points in win Sunday
news.impact: Little made all four of his kicks on Sunday, including one from 55 yards out, which left him with a nice fantasy total in this win over the Bengals. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a good option at the kicker position moving forward.

news.body: Cam Little made all five of his extra-point attempts and missed his lone field-goal attempt from 70 yards out in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Cam Little totals five points in win Sunday
news.impact: Little ended up with just five points on Sunday, which is a little disappointing considering how easily scoring came to the Jaguars against New England. He also barely missed one kick from what would have been an NFL record 70-yards out, which further hurt his fantasy total in this matchup. He should bounce back in the near future.

news.body: Cam Little made two of his three field goals and added an extra point in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Cam Little makes two FGs in Week 2
news.impact: Little hit field goals from 44 and 23 yards out in the game. The veteran kicker has hit four of his five field goals while going a perfect 5-for-5 on extra points through two games. He will take on the Patriots in Week 3.

news.body: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
news.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Cameron Dicker makes three field goals Sunday
news.impact: Dicker connected on field goals from 40, 39 and 36 yards out. Despite the Chargers struggles, he remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cameron Dicker converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts while also making his lone extra point attempt to finish with 10 points in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Dicker made the most of increased opportunities for head coach Jim Harbaugh, finishing with more than two points for the first time in three contests. The kicker has fallen victim to kicking behind an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses kick in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers didn't have much going for them on Sunday, including kicking. Dicker misses his lone field-goal against the Raiders, leaving three more points on the field for Los Angeles. Fantasy managers of the 26-year old should consider moving to a different fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Cameron Dicker did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Cameron Dicker puts just two points on the board in Week 1
news.impact: Widely viewed as one of the best fantasy options among kickers, Dicker was not given much of an opportunity to contribute on Sunday. The Chargers drastically underperformed expectations, totaling only 268 yards of offense and being dominated in time of possession. Dicker will have better games, but this one was a huge disappointment for fantasy managers.

news.body: Eddy Piñeiro made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. His field goal conversion came from 24 yards out.
news.head: Eddy Piñeiro makes four kicks in win Sunday
news.impact: Piñeiro finished with six points despite missing out on one field-goal opportunity. San Francisco continues to give him scoring chances behind one of the league's better offenses, which keeps him on the fantasy radar heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal and 3-of-5 extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro misses two extra points Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. It was a rare off day for him kicking extra points.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal but made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes five PATs in Sunday's win
news.impact: The 49ers found the end zone with each of their first five drives Sunday afternoon, and did not give Pineiro any field-goal chances. That's obviously not going to be the case each week. The veteran should be a solid fantasy option for a squad that looks really strong so far.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro (illness) will kick for the 49ers in Week 2's matchup with the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro (illness) ready to go for Sunday's game
news.impact: Pineiro has missed practice all week due to being under the weather, but the veteran kicker will be ready to go Sunday. Pineiro hit 2-of-3 field goals and all three of his PATs in Week 1.

news.body: Evan McPherson went 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in loss Sunday
news.impact: McPherson played pretty well on Sunday. He did his job and made all three of his kicks over the course of the afternoon, but Cincinnati still suffered a loss at the hands of the Jaguars. He should continue to be a pretty solid fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and all three extra point attempts in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 3
news.impact: McPherson continues to provide the Bengals with a steady leg on special teams, as he has yet to miss a kick so far this season. The 27-year-old will look to continue his strong start to the season against the Jaguars in Week 4.

news.body: Evan McPherson made both field goal and extra point attempts on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on four kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 51 and 57 yards out. He remains fairly safe for fantasy managers week-to-week.

news.body: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Harrison Mevis misses kick in win Sunday
news.impact: Mevis made four out of his five kicks on Sunday but missed one field-goal attempt against the Eagles. Luckily, the Rams were still able to pick up the win on the road, and fantasy managers should continue to regard him as a worthwhile option moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and made both of his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Harrison Mevis scores 14 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Mevis was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday night. He knocked down all six of his kicks against the Broncos, leaving him with a total of 14 points on the night. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Harrison Mevis misses kick in win Monday
news.impact: Mevis missed a field goal late in Monday night's game, but luckily for him, it wasn't very consequential with Los Angeles already being up several scores. He should return to being a solid fantasy option at the position somewhat soon.

news.body: Harrison Mevis made his only PAT attempt in the Rams' 27-7 tough loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Harrison Mevis kicks single PAT in loss to Niners
news.impact: Mevis wasn't called upon much, the Rams offense was just never in scoring position for most of the game. He could have come in in the second half, but the Rams elected to go for it on 4th and goal at the 1 yard line, which was the correct choice, but their failure to convert meant Mevis was going to have an even bigger stinker. Brighter days are ahead for the Rams kicker.

news.body: Jake Bates made all four of his field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jake Bates nails four field goals in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Bates put a total of 14 points on the board Sunday night, getting four field-goal tries, as the Lions' offense had trouble finishing drives in the end zone. Bates has yet to miss any of his seven FG attempts or 14 PATs through four games. He's a great fantasy option with the Lions' high-powered offense.

news.body: Jake Bates connected on his lone field goal attempt and all four of his extra point attempts in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in Week 3 win
news.impact: Bates was perfect after each touchdown and made his lone field goal from 30-yards out to open the scoring in the second quarter. Bates has yet to miss a kick this season and will take his perfect season on the road to Carolina in Week 4.

news.body: Jake Bates went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in loss Thursday
news.impact: Bates did his job on Thursday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, so he carries no blame for Detroit's loss to the Bills. He should continue to be a quality fantasy asset at the position moving forward.

news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as his lone field goal attempt to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.head: Jake Bates picks up seven points in Week 1
news.impact: Bates made the most of his opportunities behind a Detroit offense that battled consistency issues in the season opener. The kicker should once again be in line for plenty of opportunities in what should be a high-scoring Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers makes lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: Myers made his lone field goal from 35 yards out. He missed a 53-yard field goal earlier in the drive, but a leverage penalty on the Chargers gave the Seahawks an automatic first down.

news.body: Jason Myers converted his only field goal attempt as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Jason Myers racks up seven points in Week 3
news.impact: Myers continues a strong start to the season, recording seven points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options in related formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Jason Myers hit all four of his PATs and his lone field goal attempt in the Seahawks' 31-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers hits four PATs in win over Arizona
news.impact: Myers has had seven kicking points in each of his first two games, a solid total. He's going to continue to be productive thanks to the Seahawks offense being as potent as it is.

news.body: Jason Myers went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Jason Myers scores seven points in win Wednesday
news.impact: Myers did his job on Wednesday, knocking in all three of his kicks en route to a win over the Patriots. He will likely be a decent fantasy option at the position over the course of the season, assuming QB Sam Darnold (hip) doesn't miss significant time and leave the offense weaker moving forward.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 3-of-3 field goals and extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on all six kicks Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 51, 39 and 54 yards. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on his lone field goal attempts and two extra point attempts in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn perfect in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Fairbairn made his lone field goal attempt for 24-yard outs in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old has missed just one kick so far in the first three games. Houston will take on Dallas in Week 4.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-3 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn connected on field goals from 37 and 45 yards out. He missed from 58 yards out in the third quarter.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal try and all four of his PATs in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts seven points on the board
news.impact: Fairbairn showed off his powerful leg in Sunday's loss, nailing a 58-yard attempt to briefly give the Texans a one-point lead in the fourth quarter. The veteran has been kicking for the Texans since 2017 and remains one of the more reliable options in the league.

news.body: Spencer Shrader made 3-of-3 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders.
news.head: Spencer Shrader makes three field goals in Week 4 win
news.impact: Shrader made field goals from 44, 48, and 52 yards out to help pace the Colts to the win in London. The 27-year-old has not missed a field goal attempt this season and will look to continue his strong season against the Steelers in Week 5.

news.body: Spencer Shrader connected on all four of his field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt in a 19-17 win over the Texans.
news.head: Spencer Shrader perfect in Week 3
news.impact: Shrader reportedly sustained a groin injury in warmups Sunday, but it did not impact his performance against Houston. Shrader made field goals from 37, 39, 53, and 58 yards to help pace the Colts to their first win of the season. Shrader and the Colts will take on the Commanders in Week 3.

news.body: Spencer Shrader went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Spencer Shrader perfect in overtime loss Sunday
news.impact: Shrader did his job on Sunday night. He made all six of his kicks against the Chiefs, which left him with 12 points over the course of the night. That wasn't enough for Indianapolis to pick up the win in overtime, however, as they now drop to 0-2 on the season.

news.body: Spencer Shrader converted his only field goal attempt as well as two of his three extra point attempts to finish with five points in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
news.head: Spencer Shrader misses extra point in Week 1
news.impact: Shrader fell victim behind an underwhelming performance from the Indianapolis offense in the season opener. The kicker will hope for more opportunities in a difficult Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Ravens win over the Titans.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes 64-yard field goal in Week 4 win
news.impact: Loop connected on a 64-yard field goal attempt to close out the first half. He would later miss a 40-yard attempt late in the fourth quarter. Loop is 6-for-8 so far on field goal attempts this season.

news.body: Tyler Loop made both of his field goals and added four extra points in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Tyler Loop nails 56-yard game-winning FG in Week 3
news.impact: Loop provided the heroics as he hit a 56-yard field goal with a second left in the game to break a 31-31 tie. The veteran kicker has made five of his six field goals and added 11 extra points through three games this season. He will be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in the Ravens loss to the Saints.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes one field goal in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Loop had a 49-yard field goal blocked in the first half, but made a 49-yard field goal in the second half. The Ravens take on the Cowboys in Week 3, which should provide Loop with plenty of chances in what should be a high scoring matchup.

news.body: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win
news.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Will Reichard made all five of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Will Reichard scores 15 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Reichard had a great game on Sunday, being responsible for all 15 of Minnesota's points in their close win over the Dolphins. He should continue to be a viable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Will Reichard connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard makes five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Reichard made field goals from 54, 56 and 43 yards out. He hit two huge field goals late in the fourth quarter to help Minnesota hold off the Bucs.

news.body: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts to finish with nine points in a Week 2 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Will Reichard perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Reichard continues a strong start to the season, recording seven or more points in each of the first two games. The kicker will look to provide another solid performance against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.

news.body: Will Reichard made his lone field goal attempt and all four extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard connects on lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: Reichard made his field goal from 38 yards out. He remains a fairly reliable option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19 of 30 passing attempts for 218 yards and two touchdowns, adding 29 yards on the ground in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Brock Purdy throws two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Purdy didn't put up a big yardage total, but he took care of the football and threw both of his touchdowns in the second half. He has San Francisco at 4-0 and continues to give fantasy managers a solid floor as a low-end QB1 in one of the NFL's better offenses. Purdy will face the Seattle Seahawks in Week 5.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 15-of-27 passes for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses four touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy also had a rushing score late that was called back on a penalty by George Kittle. His first passing touchdown was a completion to Mike Evans, who lateraled the ball to Deebo Samuel for the long score. He draws a tougher matchup against the Broncos next week.

news.body: Brock Purdy connected on 20-of-22 passes for 287 yards and two touchdowns, adding 30 yards and a touchdown on three carries in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Brock Purdy turns in tremendous effort against Dolphins
news.impact: Purdy is off to an outstanding start this season, and he could hardly have been more prolific in Sunday's rout of the Dolphins. The fifth-year QB has completed a ridiculous 80.4% of his passes so far, averaging 246 yards with a 5-1 TD/INT ratio through two games. Purdy has also rushed for 59 yards on eight carries, including a two-yard scoring scramble on Sunday. He'll be a QB to start against the Cardinals in Week 3.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 25-of-34 passes for 205 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also ran five times for 29 yards.
news.head: Brock Purdy dismantles Rams defense in statement win
news.impact: Purdy was great in this game aside from a couple of hiccups, namely the interception. However, he did what he needed to and got the Niners into scoring position and helped them take advantage of the several short fields they inherited. Purdy should be a solid asset moving forward for fantasy.

news.body: Caleb Williams will not play in Week 5 against the Packers.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) will not return in Week 5
news.impact: Williams remains week-to-week. Tyson Bagent will get another start against the division rival Packers.

news.body: Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Williams will officially miss a second straight game. Bears head coach Ben Johnson won't name a QB starter on Friday between Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) missed another practice for the Bears on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) misses another practice Thursday
news.impact: Williams was sidelined for another practice on Thursday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he's a long-shot to play in Week 4. Fantasy managers of any Bears players should be gearing up for either Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum to start for Chicago against the Jets this week.

news.body: Caleb Williams did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Williams is likely to miss a second straight game this week.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 32-of-45 passes for 335 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws for 335 yards Sunday
news.impact: Prescott exploded in the second half, targeting CeeDee Lamb early and often with the two connecting on 17 catches. Prescott should remain a QB1 play on Thursday against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 25 of his 40 passes for 276 yards and one touchdown while adding 19 yards on four rushes in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3. He added a two-point conversion pass to CeeDee Lamb in the game.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Prescott turned in a solid, if unspectacular, game in the close loss to a tough Ravens team. His lone touchdown pass went to Jake Ferguson on a 19-yard pass in the third quarter. Prescott has thrown for 730 yards, seven touchdowns, and one interception through three games this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 4 against the Texans.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 26-of-31 passes for 279 yards and four touchdowns in the win over the Commanders. He added 26 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Dak Prescott tosses four touchdowns in Week 2 win
news.impact: Prescott found CeeDee Lamb for two of his four touchdowns and Jake Ferguson for the other two in a key win over a divisional rival. Prescott and the Cowboys will look to build on this strong performance as they take on the Ravens in Week 3.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 22-of-34 passing attempts for 175 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Dak Prescott underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Prescott didn't deliver a great performance on Sunday night. He was held to under 200 passing yards against the Giants and lost one turnover in Dallas' loss to their divisional rival. He will have a good opportunity to bounce back next week against the Commanders, but this is not the type of performance fantasy managers wanted to see out of him in the season opener.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 22-of-37 passes for 269 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Bills. He added 54 rushing yards on eight carries, while losing one fumble.
news.head: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 4 win
news.impact: Maye led the Patriots to a comeback win on the road against the Bills, despite struggling again with some turnovers. The former first-round pick was able to find Efton Chism on a 23-yard pass to give the team the lead with under two minutes remaining. He will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: Drake Maye (shoulder) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Maye was dealing with a minor shoulder injury throughout the week, but it's not a big deal currently and he will carry no injury designation heading into the weekend. He isn't startable in most fantasy leagues at this point in the season, but this would be a good week for him to bounce back from his rough start against a struggling Buffalo defense.

news.body: Drake Maye was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Maye continues to battle through a shoulder injury. He is a borderline QB1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Drake Maye (shoulder) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Maye is featured on New England's injury report to start the week. He's managing a minor shoulder injury right now, but he told reporters that it hasn't affected his throwing up to this point. Fantasy managers shouldn't be starting him this week, even if he wasn't on the injury report in any capacity.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 21-of-35 passing attempts for 166 yards, two touchdowns, and three interceptions in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett throws three interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Brissett didn't have a good game on Sunday. He was only able to hit 166 passing yards and threw three interceptions over the course of the afternoon, including a pick-six at the end of the game that secured the loss for Arizona. He won't be a good fantasy option moving forward, though he should continue to support Arizona's offensive weapons just fine.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 38-of-52 passes for 280 yards and two touchdowns in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett throws two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Brissett was able to play a complete game without any turnovers. They played from behind in the second half where they scored 24 points. Brissett also added a rushing score. He'll take on the Giants next week.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 17 of 28 passes for 95 yards with a touchdown and an interception in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett struggles in loss to Seattle
news.impact: Brissett did not look good in this game, failing to even crack a hundred passing yards on the day. He will try to do better against the 49ers next time out. But even that matchup is on the difficult side.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 27-of-37 passes for 277 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett leads the Cardinals to victory in Week 1
news.impact: Brissett was efficient and showed his typical veteran leadership in what most would call a season-opening upset of the Chargers. Brissett added 14 yards rushing on six carries, with a long of 11, giving him nearly 300 yards of total offense. The 11th-year veteran is coming off a career-best season, and he's now picked up right where he left off. Brissett could be a matchup-based streamer in standard leagues for the duration of the campaign.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 12-of-27 passing attempts for 93 yards and two touchdowns while adding 18 yards on the ground in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Hurts totals 111 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Hurts didn't play well on Sunday. He completed less than half of his passing attempts against the Rams and finished with just 93 passing yards, though he was still able to pick up two touchdowns through the air. He will continue to be underwhelming until DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is back in the lineup for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 16 of his 25 pass attempts for 153 yards and an interception while adding four rushes for 25 yards and a touchdown in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.head: Jalen Hurts runs for a TD, throws INT in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Hurts and the Philadelphia offense struggled in the loss to Chicago on Monday night. He briefly left the game to get checked for a concussion but was cleared to return to the contest shortly after. Hurts has thrown for 620 yards, five touchdowns, and three interceptions while adding 87 rushing yards and a touchdown on the ground in three games this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 26 of his 37 passes for 264 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding five rushes for 16 yards in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Jalen Hurts throws two TDs in Week 2
news.impact: Hurts saved the day for the Eagles, throwing a three-yard touchdown to Darius Cooper with 14 seconds left in regulation. The veteran quarterback also made some mistakes, tossing two interceptions and taking three sacks. Hurts now has five touchdown passes through two games, but he has yet to score any rushing TDs. He will be a high-end QB1 in Week 3 against the Bears on the road.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 32 of 52 passes for 412 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Jared Goff airs it out for 412 yards in Sunday night's loss
news.impact: Through Sunday, Goff now holds the NFL's highest single-game total in passing yards for the season. The Lions threw the ball 52 times compared to just 15 runs, leading to Goff's seventh career 400-yard passing performance. Surprisingly, the Lions' QB only connected for one touchdown pass on the night. Overall, Goff has been excellent through four weeks, completing 67.7% of his throws for better than 300 yards per game with a 9-0 TD/INT ratio.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 25-of-32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He also rushed for six yards on four carries.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 3
news.impact: Goff found Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs through the air to help pace the Lions to a home win over the Jets. Goff has yet to throw an interception this year and has three straight multi-touchdown games to open the season. The Lions will take on the Panthers on the road in Week 4.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-38 passing attempts for 327 yards and four touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jared Goff throws four touchdowns in win Thursday
news.impact: Goff and Detroit's offense struggled at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they were able to get things going later, and he ended up throwing four touchdowns in a shootout loss to the Buffalo Bills. He has looked terrific to start the season and should continue to be a safe week-to-week streaming option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-39 pass attempts for 206 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing twice for two yards in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Saints
news.impact: Goff took what the New Orleans defense allowed, relying on dynamic running back Jahmyr Gibbs to carry a rusty Detroit starting offense in the Week 1 win. The veteran signal-caller remains a stable mid-tier option with QB1 upside ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) will undergo season-ending surgery.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) to miss the rest of the season
news.impact: Dart had been getting multiple opinions on his ACL injury. Examination shows that the ligament is intact, but Dart will still require surgery that will end his second-season. Jameis Winston will take over as QB1 for the Giants.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) has undergone further testing on his injured knee and they have revealed it could be a season-ending injury. What looked like a promising 2026 is quickly turning upside down for the Giants.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) testing reveals knee injury could be season-ending
news.impact: Dart went down early in the first quarter with a knee injury, and did not return despite pushing to come back into the game. Now with testing revealing that his injuries could be season-ending, it’s a massive blow to fantasy managers. Jameis Winston looked shell shocked for the majority of his snaps, a far cry from the Jameis we’ve come to know and love over the past few seasons. There are a few comforts we can take from his performance, one is the fact that top WR Malik Nabers hurt his shoulder and was playing through pain. The other is that he will not have to face the Rams pass rush again this season. He could still be a streaming option if Dart is out, but don’t start him right away as we want to see a bit more promise of a bounce back first.

news.body: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is believed to have suffered a sprained MCL based on the initial exams.
news.head: Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered sprained MCL
news.impact: Dart underwent X-rays that returned negative. He will undergo an MRI on Tuesday. He is expected to miss some time, but it appears he avoided anything too serious.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of the Giants' contest against the Rams on Monday night.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) ruled out for rest of Monday Night Football
news.impact: Dart went down early in the first quarter against the Rams after getting sandwiched between two defenders. From the information on the broadcast, it does sound like Dart is OK, but he is being held out as they do further testing on his knee.

news.body: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said the goal is for Jayden Daniels to return in Week 5.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) hopeful to return in Week 5
news.impact: Daniels is slated to return to practice this week. His status will need to be monitored throughout the week.

news.body: Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not play Sunday against the Colts.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) out for Week 4
news.impact: Daniels has been progressing this week from his elbow injury, even getting in some limited practice sessions. He's still not quite ready to go, however, as Marcus Mariota will draw a second straight start behind center. Daniels will look ahead to a Week 5 matchup against the Giants.

news.body: Jayden Daniels (elbow) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Daniels was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to rehab an elbow injury that he suffered in Week 2. He doesn't look likely to play in Week 4, but we won't have official word on his status until sometime after practice on Friday probably.

news.body: Jayden Daniels is taking his recovery day to day.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) taking recovery day-to-day
news.impact: Daniels opened the week with a limited session on Wednesday. He remains unlikely to play this week, but he has a chance to return in Week 5 or 6.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 39-of-54 passing attempts for 428 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding six yards and a touchdown on the ground in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Burrow had an up-and-down performance on Sunday. On the one hand, he was able to throw for over 425 yards and logged two total touchdowns against the Jaguars. On the other hand, he threw two interceptions and led Cincinnati to score just 17 points in a loss at home. His fantasy value for next week will heavily depend on the health of Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) for their matchup against the Dolphins.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 28-of-37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He rushed for 13 yards on two carries.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Burrow was excellent for the majority of the game Sunday, finding Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and Mike Gesicki for his three touchdown passes. The veteran did fumble on what would be the final drive for the Bengals, sealing the win for the Steelers. Burrow and the Bengals will welcome the Jaguars to town in Week 4.

news.body: Joe Burrow (back) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Joe Burrow (back) off injury report for Week 3
news.impact: Burrow was reportedly dealing with some soreness coming into the week, but it's not a serious issue and he carries no injury designation ahead of Week 3. He should be a full go against the Steelers, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Joe Burrow is dealing with soreness.
news.head: Joe Burrow dealing with soreness
news.impact: It is unclear how much Burrow will practice on Wednesday. He is day-to-day for now.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 22 of his 30 passes for 197 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Jordan Love throws two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Love turned in a solid game in the close win over Tampa Bay. His touchdown passes went to Tucker Kraft and Matthew Golden. Love has now thrown for 1,041 yards, eight touchdowns, and three interceptions through four games. He will be a high-end QB2 heading into Week 5's matchup against the Bears.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 28 of 53 passes for 312 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons. He also ran once for no gain.
news.head: Jordan Love passes for 312 yards in loss
news.impact: Love was a bit up and down in this game. He was struggling against the pressure Atlanta was bringing, missing several forced throws and causing tipped passes. The Green Bay offense has no run game, which has worked out decently well for the pass catchers, but until they get things going on the ground to make the defense respect the run, it will be hard for the receivers and Love to have a ceiling week in, week out.

news.body: Jordan Love told reporters that his elbow injury is a non-issue for Week 3 against the Falcons.
news.head: Jordan Love says elbow is non-issue for Week 3
news.impact: Love said discomfort in his elbow went away before Jets game ended. He indicated the elbow is a non-issue for the Falcons game, even on a short week.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 16-of-29 pass attempts for 145 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
news.head: Jordan Love tosses two touchdowns in Week 2 win over Jets
news.impact: Love continues a solid start to the season as part of a Green Bay offense battling inconsistency early on, throwing two touchdowns in each of the first two games. The quarterback will look for more sizeable success for fantasy managers in a favorable Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passes for 254 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the loss to the Patriots. He rushed for four yards and a touchdown on five carries.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for two touchdowns in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Allen turned in a solid day Sunday, including a touchdown pass to Keon Coleman late in the game. Allen was without DJ Moore, who left the game in the first half with a shoulder injury. His interception late in the game ended up a comeback and handed the Bills their first loss of the season. Allen and the Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Josh Allen is without an injury designation ahead of Week 4's matchup against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Josh Allen without injury designation for Week 4
news.impact: There was some concern that Allen suffered a minor injury of some kind in last week's win over the Chargers, but that's not the case and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 4. He should be a full go and remains a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 16-of-26 pass attempts for 204 yards and two interceptions while also rushing eight times for 22 yards and two touchdowns with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Josh Allen reaches end zone on ground twice in Week 3 win over Chargers
news.impact: Allen made up for a mistake-filled day behind center rushing for two touchdowns for the third consecutive contests. The quarterback remains locked in as an elite dual-threat option behind center in all formats, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 20-of-31 passing attempts for 248 yards and three touchdowns while adding 69 yards and two touchdowns on the ground in Sunday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Josh Allen scores five touchdowns in dominant showing Thursday
news.impact: Allen had an insane showing on Thursday night. He totaled over 300 yards and scored five total touchdowns en route to a big win over the Lions in primetime, all while protecting the ball and committing zero turnovers. He has been absolutely dominant through the first two games of the season and is pacing to be one of, if not the most valuable individual player that anyone can roster at this point.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 27-of-37 passing attempts for 247 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Kyler Murray scoreless in win Sunday
news.impact: Murray took care of the ball on Sunday, but he wasn't able to get much going against the Dolphins and didn't score a touchdown during the team's win. He shouldn't be considered a good fantasy option moving forward, especially if Justin Jefferson (ankle) has to miss more time.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 15-of-29 passes for 168 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray has underwhelming day Sunday
news.impact: Murray was playing in his first game back from the concussion protocol. He lost Justin Jefferson early for the day. He targeted Jordan Addison heavily, including on a 41-yard touchdown. He'll face the Dolphins next week.

news.body: Kyler Murray has cleared concussion protocol and will start against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start Week 3
news.impact: Murray missed the Vikings Week 2 slog of a win over the Bears, but he will be back in the lineup for Week 3 against a hapless Tampa defense. Murray is still a bit of an unknown at this point given he barely played in Week 1, but this is a perfect matchup to return to.

news.body: Kyler Murray (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Kyler Murray (concussion) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Murray was progressing well through the NFL's concussion protocols this week, but he will ultimately have to end up missing a game due to the big hit that he suffered in Week 1. It looks likely that he will be back in time for Week 3, but Carson Wentz is expected to serve as Minnesota's starter in the meantime, which is good news for the fantasy value of Justin Jefferson in a prime matchup against the Bears this week.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has only an outside chance of playing Sunday against the Falcons.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) unlikely to play in Week 5
news.impact: Jackson sustained a sprained ankle in Week 4's win over the Titans. Now, the two-time MVP's status is uncertain for the next few weeks. The Ravens have not officially ruled him out for this Sunday's game, but the chances of him playing seem very thin. Tyler Huntley would be set to step in at quarter in Jackson's stead.

news.body: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Monday he didn’t know the chances of Lamar Jackson playing in Week 5.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) status for Week 5 uncertain
news.impact: Minter added that he didn’t think “it’s going to be crazy long-term.” Jackson will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is considered day-to-day with an ankle injury.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) considered day-to-day
news.impact: Jackson was listed as questionable to return Sunday, but he remained on the sideline for the rest of the game. Jackson was seen exiting the stadium in a boot, but head coach Jesse Minter appeared to be optimistic about Jackson's prognosis. The Ravens take on the Falcons in Week 5.

news.body: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is questionable to return against the Titans.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) questionable to return
news.impact: Jackson was seen limping into the locker room to end the first half. He returned to the sideline prior to the start of the second half, but did not have his helmet. Tyler Huntley appears set to quarterback the Ravens the rest of the way Sunday. Jackson was 15-of-20 for 222 yards and two touchdowns prior to the injury.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 32-of-51 passing attempts for 317 yards and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Matthew Stafford doesn't score in win Sunday
news.impact: Stafford was able to lead the Rams to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to find a lot of personal success in the process. He failed to score even a single touchdown in this matchup, and he also threw two interceptions, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back and return to form sometime in the near future, however,

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 30-of-55 passing attempts for 390 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 13 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Matthew Stafford totals 403 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stafford had an up-and-down game on Sunday night. He finished with over 400 total yards and two touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. He made some mistakes that opened the door for Denver to win this game, but fantasy managers should be happy with his production and should continue to start him in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 22-of-31 passing attempts for 327 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses four touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: The reigning MVP had a great bounce-back game on Monday night after a disappointing season opener last week. He scored four touchdowns against the Giants and limited his mistakes overall, helping lead Los Angeles to a blowout win over New York. The only questions for him moving forward will be consistency and the health of his wideouts, with Puka Nacua (hip) currently out of the lineup for the Rams.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 15-of-25 passes for 155 yards and a pick in the Rams' 27-7 blowout loss to the 49ers. He also ran twice for a loss of a yard.
news.head: Matthew Stafford quiet in loss to Niners
news.impact: Stafford was not in his best form on Thursday, missing throws and looking a little rusty. It's a rough start for a team that was deemed Super Bowl-bound, but he will look to get back on track next week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 15 of his 30 passes for 225 yards and two touchdowns in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II throws two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Mahomes managed to hold off an upstart Raiders squad that gave the Chiefs everything they could handle. Both of his touchdown passes went to Tyquan Thornton in the win. Mahomes has now thrown for 1,037 yards, nine touchdowns, and two interceptions through four games. He will be on bye in Week 5 before going up against the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 20-of-24 pass attempts for 246 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing once for one yard in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses two touchdowns in Week 3 win
news.impact: Mahomes II continues a dynamic start to the season behind center, posting two or more touchdowns in each of the first three games. The superstar quarterback has turned back the clock for head coach Andy Reid to begin the season, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 32-of-47 passing attempts for 382 yards and three touchdowns while adding 17 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Mahomes had an electric game on Sunday night, throwing three touchdowns and totaling nearly 400 yards en route to a narrow win over the Colts. He has been terrific since his return from injury and should be considered a worthwhile starter with week-to-week upside on any given week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) was listed as a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) listed as full participant Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Mahomes continues to carry on at full health, logging a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should have very few concerns with his premature return from injury at this point, since he demonstrated his health in Week 1 in Kansas City's big win over the Broncos.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 18-of-23 passing attempts for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence was able to lead the Jaguars to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to rack up many fantasy points in the process, finishing with just one touchdown over the course of the afternoon.
