news.impact: Week 3 was shaping up to be a perfect situation for Judkins, but he didn't end up performing well and finished with 79 scoreless yards against the Panthers. He isn't worth starting moving forward, especially in less than favorable matchups.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (personal) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Judkins landed on the injury report for personal reasons this week. He'll remain an RB2 off volume this week for fantasy managers.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins (personal) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (personal) limited at practice on Thursday
news.impact: The young running back was a limited participant at practice on Thursday due to a personal issue of some kind. It doesn't seem likely to threaten his availability for Sunday's game, but we won't know more for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 47 yards and a touchdown on 13 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson sees 16 touches in Week 4 win
news.impact: Stevenson found the end zone on a one-yard plunge in the second-quarter. Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson split time in the backfield, and fantasy managers should expect more of the same against the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball seven times for 22 yards and caught three passes for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson inefficient in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stevenson was ineffective for the Patriots on Sunday. He was only able to contribute 22 yards on the ground, and he wasn't able to do much through the air either in their blowout loss to the Jaguars. He shouldn't be started in most fantasy leagues for the foreseeable future, especially with TreVeyon Henderson seeing more carries than him this week.

news.body: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson tallied 43 rushing yards on six carries in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers. He caught 1-of-2 targets for three yards.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson limited to six carries in Week 2
news.impact: Stevenson saw the majority of the carries go to TreVeyon Henderson after Stevenson fumbled the ball in the first quarter. Stevenson struggled with fumbles in 2025 and that could impact his usage moving forward if he is unable to improve his ball security. Stevenson and the Patriots will take on the Jaguars in Week 3.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball 18 times for 51 yards and caught five passes for 44 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson totals 95 yards Wednesday
news.impact: Stevenson was New England's workhorse running back on Wednesday night with TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) out of the lineup. He ran at an inefficient clip of 2.8 yards per carry on the night, but his fantasy total was saved by the fact that he caught five passes. He will be more efficient than this in the future but will lose passing work to Henderson when he's back, so he will likely continue to be touchdown dependent on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports there is a “pretty good chance” Rico Dowdle returns in Week 5 against the Colts.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (toe) has 'pretty good chance' to return in Week 5
news.impact: Dowdle was ruled out for Thursday’s game against the Browns. He'll miss a second straight game with Jaylen Warren continuing to lead the Steelers backfield in his place.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (toe) ruled out for Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back is going to be sidelined for a second-straight game on Thursday night. He's still dealing with a toe injury and was not able to take part in any of Pittsburgh's practice this week. He could miss more time beyond this game, and Jaylen Warren will continue to serve as the team's clear-cut RB1 in Dowdle's absence.

news.body: Rico Dowdle did not practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (toe) misses practice Tuesday
news.impact: Dowdle is likely to remain sidelined on Thursday against the Browns. Jaylen Warren should remain in the lead role.

news.body: Rico Dowdle is listed as a DNP on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (toe) listed as 'DNP' on Monday’s estimated practice report
news.impact: Dowdle was sidelined this past week. He is likely to remain sidelined for the Steelers on a short week against the Browns. Jaylen Warren would remain the clear lead back for Pittsburgh.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed 11 times for 40 yards, while RJ Harvey had seven carries for 25 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Harvey also caught 10 passes for 68 yards out of the backfield.
news.head: RJ Harvey, J.K. Dobbins struggle in loss Sunday
news.impact: Denver couldn't get much going on the ground, with Dobbins and Harvey combining for just 65 rushing yards. Dobbins continued to handle more of the rushing work, but Harvey was much more involved as a receiver and ended up leading the Broncos in both receptions and receiving yards. The backfield remains a split, with Dobbins having the better chance at early-down work and Harvey carrying more upside in the passing game.

news.body: RJ Harvey is off the injury report on Wednesday.
news.head: RJ Harvey (concussion) off injury report
news.impact: Harvey was checked for a concussion in Week. He will be good to go in his complimentary role next to J.K. Dobbins.

news.body: RJ Harvey hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 41 yards and rushed the ball two times for six yards in Sunday night's 30-26 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: RJ Harvey hauls in six passes Sunday
news.impact: The young running back was able to make his return to the lineup on Sunday night after missing last week's game due to a hamstring issue. He looked okay in his first game back, seeing a lot of involvement as a receiver but very little work as a rusher against the Rams. His role will continue to be limited for the team moving forward, though he might have to step up and play a bigger role than usual with Jonah Coleman (ankle) set to miss several weeks at least.

news.body: RJ Harvey (hamstring) will play in Sunday night's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: RJ Harvey (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.impact: Harvey is set to make his return to the field in Week 3 after being sidelined for one game due to a hamstring issue. He should see a full workload against the Rams this week, especially with rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) set to be sidelined in that matchup.

news.body: Saquon Barkley is considered week-to-week with his hamstring injury.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) considered week-to-week
news.impact: It is not believed to be a serious injury, but Barkley will likely be sidelined in Week 5 against the Jaguars.

news.body: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said he’ll “have more answers Wednesday” on Saquon Barkley’s hamstring injury.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) without update on injury
news.impact: Barkley went down early in Sunday’s game against the Rams. His status is up in the air heading into Week 5 against the Jaguars.

news.body: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball two times for eight yards and caught one pass for two yards before leaving Sunday's loss to the Rams with a hamstring injury.
news.head: Saquon Barkley suffers hamstring injury Sunday
news.impact: Barkley suffered a hamstring injury during Sunday's loss to the Rams. The severity of the injury is unknown at this point, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his status throughout the week. Tank Bigsby will be primed for more work if the veteran has to miss any time.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Week 4 contest between the Philadelphia Eagles and Los Angeles Rams according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Barkley will remain sidelined after suffering the hamstring injury in the first half Sunday, carrying the ball twice for eight yards and catching his lone target for two yards prior to exiting. Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley take over backfield duties for head coach Nick Sirianni.

news.body: Tony Pollard rushed for 48 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Titans' loss to the Ravens. Pollard caught 2-of-4 targets for two yards.
news.head: Tony Pollard finds the end zone in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Pollard entered the game as the favorite to see the bulk of the carries for the Titans, with Tyjae Spears receiving just two carries. Pollard continues to see plenty of carries, but has not been able to do much yardage wise this season. Pollard and the Titans will take on the Texans in Week 5.

news.body: Tony Pollard (foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Tony Pollard (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Pollard is going to be good to go for Sunday's game, despite being on the injury report all week due to a foot issue. He will see the vast majority of touches in this backfield if Tyjae Spears (ankle) is sidelined for this matchup.

news.body: Tony Pollard (foot) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (foot) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: Pollard was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being absent on Wednesday as part of the team's injury management for his foot. He should be good to go for Week 4 and will be primed for a large workload if Tyjae Spears (ankle) is limited or sidelined against the Ravens on Sunday.

news.body: Tony Pollard (foot) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (foot) officially a non-participant Wednesday
news.impact: We knew earlier in the day that Pollard wasn't going to practice, but it turns out that he is listed with a foot injury rather than an ankle issue. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status throughout the week, especially with Tyjae Spears (ankle) also not practicing for the Titans.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve
news.impact: The Saints have decided to place Etienne on injured reserve, which means that he is going to be sidelined for at least the next four weeks. He may be out longer than that as well, but the team has yet to place a concrete timetable on his recovery. Look for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller to both shoulder a much bigger workload in this backfield for the foreseeable future as a result of his absence.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Travis Etienne Jr. “will miss time."
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to miss extended time
news.impact: Etienne does not hold a clear timetable to return. Alvin Kamara should take on a bigger role in the Saints backfield with Kendre Miller also taking on a bigger role behind him.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. exited Sunday’s contest between the New Orleans Saints against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ross Jackson.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. exits early Sunday
news.impact: Etienne Jr. headed to the locker room for further evaluation, rushing 13 times for 57 yards while also hauling in both of his targets for 13 yards prior to exiting. Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take over backfield duties in the running back’s absence.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. has been cleared for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Etienne has been dealing with a hamstring injury this week. He'll be a risky RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 42 yards on 14 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He did not record a reception on his two targets.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson sees 14 touches in Week 4 win
news.impact: Henderson saw just one more carry that Rhamondre Stevenson, but failed to do much on his 14 touches. Fantasy managers should expect Stevenson and Henderson to continue to split time in the backfield in Week 5 against Las Vegas.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson rushed the ball eight times for 23 yards and caught one pass for six yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson totals 29 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: New England's offense wasn't able to get anything going on Sunday, and Henderson was no exception to that. He totaled just 29 yards on nine opportunities against the Jaguars, which burned any fantasy managers who started him in this matchup. He should not be started in most leagues until New England figures out their offensive issues.

news.body: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson tallied 76 rushing yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson finds the end zone in season debut
news.impact: Henderson missed Week 1 with an ankle injury, but made an immediate impact with a 39-yard touchdown early in the win over Pittsburgh. Rhamondre Stevenson lost a fumble and saw the bulk of the work go to Henderson after the turnover. Fantasy managers should expect both Stevenson and Henderson to have roles against the Jaguars in Week 3.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is off of the injury report and officially good to go for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially good to go for Sunday
news.impact: New England's offense is set to get a much-needed boost this week with their young running back off of the injury report and set to make his season debut on Sunday. Henderson projects to be something of a 'boom-or-bust' fantasy option on a week-to-week basis while he continues to split work with Rhamondre Stevenson in the Patriots' backfield.

news.body: Tyjae Spears rushed for seven yards on two carries in the Titans loss to the Ravens. He caught his lone target for a loss of a yard.
news.head: Tyjae Spears sees three touches in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Spears continues to mange an ankle injury, but continues to see limited rushing attempts by Tony Pollard. With just 15 rushing attempts this season, he is a handcuff at best heading into Week 5.

news.body: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Ravens.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (ankle) officially active for Week 4
news.impact: Spears was listed as questionable to play Sunday, but his full practice Friday was encouraging. He will work with Tony Pollard out of the Titans' backfield in a tough matchup against Baltimore.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Spears is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still managing an ankle injury, so the team officially has him listed as questionable to play right now. Tony Pollard will be the team's clear-cut RB1 if Spears if ruled out ahead of game time against the Ravens.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (ankle) returns to practice in limited fashion Thursday
news.impact: Spears was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being absent on Wednesday due to an ankle issue. He seems likely to play in Week 4, although it remains to be seen whether or not he will be limited in any capacity.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier rushed the ball eight times for 42 yards and a touchdown while catching two passes for seven yards through the air in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was able to contribute on Sunday, finishing with 49 total yards and a touchdown in the team's loss to the Giants. It seems like rookie Jeremiyah Love is dealing with some bumps and bruises right now too, so Allgeier could see more work in the future if the rookie is limited by that at all.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for -1 yard on two carries in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers on Sunday. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 10 yards receiving.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier has quiet day Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier took a step back to rookie RB Jeremiyah Love for the first time this season on the day. If this trend continues, he'll remain a pure stash for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran five times for 10 yards and caught both of his targets for 9 yards in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier gets seven touches in loss
news.impact: Allgeier played second fiddle to Jeremiyah Love on Sunday, which is to be expected. He wasn't particularly efficient on his limited work, but no one in the offense really got going anyway. It was tough sledding for the veteran, but hopefully things will get a little easier against San Fransisco next Sunday.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier gained 61 yards on 17 carries and nine yards on two receptions in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier leads Arizona rushing attack in Week 1
news.impact: Allgeier shouldered the majority of the backfield load for the Cardinals on Sunday, getting six more carries than Jeremiyah Love. Allgeier was not especially impressive, averaging just 3.6 yards per carry with a long of 11. Allgeier will remain involved, but the share of the carries should tilt more toward Love as the rookie gets further removed from the ankle sprain he sustained a month ago.

news.body: Will Shipley rushed the ball six times for 23 yards in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Will Shipley quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Shipley saw six touches on Sunday, but he was only able to turn them into 23 yards against the Rams, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He may see more work than usual moving forward if starter Saquon Barkley has to miss time with his hamstring injury.

news.body: Will Shipley (foot) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot) cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: Shipley was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is now off of the injury report for Week 4. He should play without any limitations but will likely continue to be relegated to a depth role behind Saquon Barkley for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Will Shipley (foot) was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot) upgraded to limited Thursday
news.impact: Shipley was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being absent from Wednesday's practice due to a foot issue. He is expected to continue to play his usual depth role in this week and beyond.

news.body: Will Shipley did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Shipley remains off the fantasy radar with Saquon Barkley on the field.

news.body: Woody Marks ran for 22 yards on six carries and a touchdown in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Woody Marks scores again Sunday
news.impact: Marks continues to play a role in the Texans backfield next to David Montgomery. Neither of them got much going on the ground. He'll be an upside flex play next week against the Titans.

news.body: Woody Marks rushed for 15 yards and a touchdown on five carries in a 19-17 loss to the Colts. He caught his lone target for six yards.
news.head: Woody Marks finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Marks found the end zone for the first time this season on a one-yard plunge in the fourth quarter. With David Montgomery struggling over the last two weeks, the Texans may look to Marks to carry the ball more in Week 4 against Dallas.

news.body: Woody Marks ran for eight yards on eight carries in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards receiving.
news.head: Woody Marks active in receiving game Sunday
news.impact: Marks and David Montgomery were both completely shut down on the ground. Marks salvaged his afternoon with five receptions. He will be on the flex radar in deeper leagues next week against the Colts.

news.body: Woody Marks rushed for 42 yards on nine carries and caught his only target for a two-yard loss in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Woody Marks gets 10 touches in Week 1
news.impact: Marks was certainly involved in the offense behind new workhorse back David Montgomery on Sunday. Marks averaged close to 5.0 yards per carry on his nine attempts. He'll remain a useful handcuff to Montgomery for now.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
news.head: AJ Barner quiet Sunday
news.impact: Barner was coming off a big performance last week. He remains a volatile TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught five of his nine targets for 69 yards in the Seahawks’ 33-31 Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders.
news.head: AJ Barner catches five passes in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Barner has seen minimal involvement in the Seattle passing attack early on, recording more than two receptions for the first time in three contests Sunday. The tight end remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught his only target for eight yards and ran in a one-yard touchdown on his only carry in Seattle's 31-7 win over Arizona.
news.head: AJ Barner runs in touchdown in win over Cardinals
news.impact: Barner's fantasy day was saved by the touchdown, as he hasn't gotten much volume to start the season. He's touchdown-or-bust right now and is best left on the bench or on waivers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught two passes for 13 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: AJ Barner catches two passes Wednesday
news.impact: The Seahawks were able to pick up a win over the Patriots on Wednesday, but they didn't need to get Barner very involved in order to do so. He finished the game with just two catches for 13 yards, and there's not much reason to believe that he will bounce back and become a quality week-to-week option anytime soon.

news.body: Brenton Strange hauled in 7-of-8 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Brenton Strange leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end stepped up on Sunday. He finished as the team's top receiver with 95 yards against the Bengals, which was very timely on an afternoon where most of their receiving options were struggling. He had a good fantasy total in this game, but managers shouldn't expect this to be a regular thing for him moving forward.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught 3-of-5 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Brenton Strange catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Strange was a solid contributor for the Jaguars on Sunday, hauling in three passes en route to a big win over the Patriots. Still, he isn't a strong fantasy option and shouldn't be considered startable for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 17 yards in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Brenton Strange catches two balls in Week 2
news.impact: Strange was quiet in a game where the defenses led the way. The veteran tight end has now caught four of his five targets for 40 yards and a touchdown over two games. He will be on the TE2 radar in fantasy for his Week 3 matchup against the Patriots.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught two of three targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Brenton Strange grabs touchdown in win over Browns
news.impact: Strange was among ten other targeted receivers who were trying to feast off of an extremely small pie of 21 total targets. And he was one of the lucky ones with a touchdown. He should continue to see work as the top tight end for the offense, but things are so spread out that it might be hard to rely on him on a weekly basis.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught six of his 11 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Brock Bowers finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Bowers turned in a second straight dominant game for the Raiders. He found the end zone on a 20-yard pass from Kirk Cousins in the fourth quarter. Bowers now has 16 catches for 202 yards and two touchdowns in two games. He will be a top fantasy TE option in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

news.body: Brock Bowers (knee) is without an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Brock Bowers (knee) without injury designation for Sunday
news.impact: Bowers was limited at practice on Friday due to the knee injury that he's still dealing with, but it's not a big issue for him at this point and he is off of the injury report heading into the weekend. Fantasy managers should expect him to play and continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset moving forward, assuming he can stay healthy and on the field.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught 10-of-13 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints.
news.head: Brock Bowers dominates in return Sunday
news.impact: Bowers was making his season debut and he did not miss a beat. He was involved early and often. He remains a high-end TE1 moving forward.

news.body: Brock Bowers (knee) is officially active for Week 3 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Brock Bowers (knee) active for Week 3
news.impact: Bowers will take the field for his regular season debut after passing through pregame testing on his knee without any setbacks, providing quarterback Kirk Cousins with a dynamic pass-catching option against the Saints Sunday.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Colston Loveland goes for 57 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Loveland turned in his best game of the season, leading the Bears in catches and targets. It was a welcome sight after he had just five catches through the first three games. The second-year tight end now has 11 catches for 91 scoreless yards in four games. He will be on the TE1 radar in Week 5 against Green Bay.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3's Monday night game.
news.head: Colston Loveland hauls in four balls in Week 3
news.impact: Loveland got off to a quick start, bringing in a four-yard pass from Case Keenum on the second play of the game. The Week 3 effort goes down as Loveland's best of the season as he was shut out in Week 1 and held to three receiving yards in Week 2. He has now caught five passes for 34 yards through three games. Loveland will look to break out in Week 4 against the Jets.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught one of his three targets for three yards in the Bears' 9-3 Week 2 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Colston Loveland catches one pass in Week 2
news.impact: Loveland has struggled to make an impact to begin the season, recording one reception or less in each of the first two games. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option ahead of a Week 3 matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles.

news.body: Colston Loveland failed to catch either of his two targets in the Bears' 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Colston Loveland sees two targets in Week 1
news.impact: Loveland was non-existent in an explosive Chicago offense for head coach Ben Johnson in the season opener, operating as more of an afterthought in the win. The tight end will look to get back on track in a Week 2 divisional contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) won't play Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Goedert is going to be sidelined for another game in Week 4 as he continues to recover from a knee issue. Devonta Smith (hamstring) is also going to be sidelined, so the Eagles will need to look to Dontayvion Wicks and rookie Makai Lemon to step up in this matchup against Los Angeles.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) was not seen at Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) not at practice Thursday
news.impact: As expected, the veteran tight end was not seen participating in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday. He's still recovering from a knee injury and is likely to miss more time before he's back in the lineup. Zach Ertz will continue to see increased run for however long Goedert remains out moving forward.

news.body: Dallas Goedert did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Goedert remains likely to miss another game.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) will not be placed on injured reserve but is still expected to be sidelined for a few weeks.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) to avoid IR, expected to miss a few weeks
news.impact: Goedert suffered a knee injury last week and the team considered placing him on injured reserve, but they are not going to do so, as he is only expected to miss a few weeks while he recovers. This is good news for fantasy managers of the veteran, but they will still need to find a substitute for him for the foreseeable future while he's out. Zach Ertz will step up and see more work for the Eagles in his absence.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards in the loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 4
news.impact: Kincaid set new season lows in all receiving metrics in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers will hope that Kincaid bounces back in a Week 5 matchup against the Rams.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid hauled in two of his three targets for 38 yards and one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 3 win over Chargers
news.impact: Kincaid was held in check by the Los Angeles defense, failing to surpass 90 receiving yards for the first time in three contests in the win. The tight end remains one of the more impactful pass-catching options for quarterback Josh Allen, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught 7-of-8 passing attempts for 95 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid electric in win Thursday
news.impact: Kincaid's great start to the season continued on Thursday night. He was Buffalo's leading receiver against the Lions and was able to get into the end zone on one of his seven catches, which left him with a great fantasy total. It looks like he may be in the midst of a big breakout season right now, so long as he and QB Josh Allen stay healthy for the majority of the season.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught five of six targets for 130 yards in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid has breakout game against Texans
news.impact: Kincaid had arguably his best game as a pro, acheiving a career-high 130 receiving yards in what should have been tough sledding against Houston. He tied with Khalil Shakir for second in targets on the Bills, but vastly outproduced Shakir in yards. His downfield usage was encouraging, and it’s a promising start to his fourth season. Now to see if it keeps up.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Dalton Schultz quiet Sunday
news.impact: Schultz continues to be less reliable for fantasy managers with Nico Collins on the field.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in three catches in Week 3
news.impact: Schultz saw his lowest target share of the season Sunday and had an incredible drop of from his 12 receptions in Week 2. The Houston offense struggled in general against the Colts' defense, and they will need to bounce back against Dallas to avoid going 0-4 on the season.

news.body: Dalton Schultz returned to practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dalton Schultz (rest) back at practice Thursday
news.impact: After a huge performance on Sunday, Schultz received a rest day to begin the practice week. If Nico Collins remains sidelined, he'll be in line for TE1 volume once again.

news.body: Dalton Schultz (rest) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dalton Schultz (rest) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: The Texans gave Schultz Wednesday's practice off as a veteran rest day for him after he caught 12 passes in Week 2. He should be back in the lineup very soon and will be primed for more work than usual again this week if Nico Collins (hamstring) is sidelined for another game.

news.body: George Kittle caught four of his six targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: George Kittle scores long touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: Most of Kittle's production came on one play, but fantasy managers won't complain. He took a short pass 56 yards for a touchdown late in the fourth quarter to put the game away. Kittle remains a middle-of-the-pack TE1 in fantasy when healthy.

news.body: George Kittle caught 6-of-7 targets for 82 yards and two touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: George Kittle scores twice Sunday
news.impact: Kittle took on a bigger role with Mike Evans (rib) exiting early. He hauled in two touchdowns from Brock Purdy in the win. He remains a strong TE1, especially if Evans misses time.

news.body: George Kittle secured all four of his targets for 80 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: George Kittle finds the end zone in Week 2
news.impact: With his Achilles injury further behind him, Kittle's playmaking ability was on display Sunday. The veteran TE led the 49ers in receiving yards and had the longest gain of the day with a 40-yard pickup. Kittle also scored his first touchdown of the campaign on a 12-yard pass from Brock Purdy early in the third quarter. As long as he's healthy, Kittle is among the top TEs in the league.

news.body: George Kittle (Achilles) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: George Kittle (Achilles) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Kittle carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be available to play against the Dolphins. It seems likely that he will continue to be limited in some capacity, though it looks like the 49ers are planning on ramping his workload up more and more each week moving forward.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. came up with 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. finds the end zone again in Week 4
news.impact: After scoring twice in Week 3, Fannin hauled in another touchdown toss from Deshaun Watson on Thursday night. Fannin did not start off great in a season-opening loss to the Jaguars, but during the Browns' current three-game winning streak, the second-year pro has totaled 15 grabs for 132 yards. Fannin is cementing his TE1 status.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 21-18 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. hauls in two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Fannin had a great game on Sunday. He was Cleveland's leader in receptions and yards against the Panthers, and he was also able to get into the end zone twice to put the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should be happy with his performance in this game but should expect struggles with consistency for him moving forward.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught 5-of-6 targets for 54 yards in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Fannin was able to bounce back after being held without a catch last week. He remains a low-end TE1 heading into next week against the Panthers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught two of three targets for 21 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. held in check on Sunday
news.impact: Fannin was held in check on Sunday, along with the rest of the Browns' offense. He will hope for better days next week against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught all five of his targets for 62 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
news.impact: Henry led the team in receiving yards, and caught the pass to seal the win late in the fourth quarter. His five receptions and 62 yards mark new season highs for the veteran. Henry will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught 1-of-2 targets for just five yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Hunter Henry a non-factor in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end wasn't able to contribute for the Patriots on Sunday. He finished with just one five-yard catch against the Jaguars, which left him with a very poor fantasy total. He can't be trusted as a streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Patriots TE Hunter Henry caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes in Week 2 win
news.impact: Henry led the team in targets and was tied with Romeo Doubs for the team lead in receptions. Henry should continue to see a steady volume with A.J. Brown on injured reserve. The veteran tight end will head to Jacksonville for a Week 3 matchup with the Jaguars.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught three passes for 26 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes Wednesday
news.impact: New England's offense wasn't very effective on Wednesday night, and Henry was no exception to that. He totaled just 26 scoreless yards against the Seahawks, which left him with a poor fantasy total. His value as a streaming option may be diminished this year with Eli Raridon seemingly primed to be more involved at the tight end position for the Patriots.

news.body: Isaiah Likely hauled in 7-of-12 targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: Likely had a nice bounce-back game on Sunday, finishing with seven catches for 66 yards in the team's win over the Cardinals. He could prove to have solid week-to-week fantasy upside with Jameis Winston at the helm for the Giants, but he will likely continue to struggle with consistency moving forward.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught 2-of-5 targets for just 13 yards in Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Isaiah Likely quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wasn't able to get much going on Sunday, finishing with just 13 yards in the team's narrow win over the Titans. He isn't likely to return to fantasy relevance for however long QB Jameis Winston is starting for New York, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any hesitations to drop him at this point.

news.body: Isaiah Likely hauled in 5-of-10 targets for 33 yards in Monday night's 28-6 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in five passes Monday
news.impact: Likely didn't put up great numbers on Monday night, finishing with just 33 yards in a loss to the Rams. He was still the most targeted player on the team by far, however, which is a good sign that he will bounce back and return to form sometime in the near future. His bounce back may be delayed is Jaxson Dart (knee) has to miss time for the Giants.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught eight passes for 78 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Likely exceeded expectations in his first game as a Giant on Sunday. He led the team in receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns on the night, scoring twice in what turned out to be a huge win over the Cowboys. His involvement on this offense looks great right now and he will likely be one of the hot waiver additions this week in any league he's not already rostered in.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught 3-of-4 targets for 11 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: Jake Ferguson quiet Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson spent most of the afternoon blocking against the Texans pass rush. He remains a touchdown dependent tight end on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught three of his five targets for 23 yards and a touchdown while losing a fumble in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Jake Ferguson finds the end zone in Week 3
news.impact: Ferguson hauled in a 19-yard touchdown pass from Dak Prescott in the third quarter. The veteran tight end has racked up nine catches for 72 yards and three touchdowns through three games this season. He will be on the TE1 radar in Week 4's matchup against a tough Houston defense.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught all four of his targets for 43 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys win over the Commanders.
news.head: Jake Ferguson finds the end zone twice in Week 2
news.impact: Ferguson was quiet in Week 1, so this was a much needed bounce back performance. The 27-year-old remains the primary pass catching option out of the tight end group. Ferguson will look to build on this performance in Week 3 against the Ravens.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught just two passes for six yards in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Jake Ferguson quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end didn't make an impact on Sunday night. He was held to just two catches and six total yards against the Giants, which was a symptom of Dallas' offensive struggles against their divisional rivals. Ferguson isn't expected to be fantasy relevant anytime in the foreseeable future.

news.body: Juwan Johnson hauled in 6-of-8 targets for 59 yards in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Juwan Johnson hauls in six passes Monday
news.impact: The veteran tight end had a nice outing on Monday night. He finished with six receptions for 59 yards over the course of the game, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy total. He will continue to be a reliable week-to-week option until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is available to make his debut for the Saints.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught 8-of-8 targets for 53 yards in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
news.head: Juwan Johnson catches two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: It must have been tight end day in New Orleans as the two teams combined for six touchdowns caught by tight ends. Johnson remains a steady weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught 4-of-4 passes for 66 yards in the Saints 24-17 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Juwan Johnson hauls in four passes in Week 2
news.impact: Johnson continues to serve as the primary passing option out of the Saints' tight end group. The 30-year-old veteran has topped 50+ receiving yards in the first two games of the season and appears poised to turn in solid performances in an improved Saints' offense. Johnson and the Saints will take on the Raiders in Week 3.

news.body: Juwan Johnson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: Juwan Johnson (illness) off injury report Week 2
news.impact: Johnson was a late addition to the injury report this week with an illness. He'll be on the TE1/TE2 radar for fantasy managers this week.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq was unable to catch any of his four targets in a 23-12 loss to the Bears in Week 4.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq held without a catch in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Sadiq was dealing with a back injury throughout the week but he was ultimately able to suit up vs. Chicago. He tied for the team lead in targets but was unable to do anything with them on a rough day for the New York passing offense. He now has 12 catches for 143 yards and one touchdown through four games. Sadiq will look to bounce back as a low-end TE1 in Week 5 against the Browns.

news.body: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq (back) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Bears.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (back) officially active for Week 4
news.impact: Sadiq was limited in each practice session this week but has been cleared to play Sunday. The rookie should see plenty of opportunities with WR Adonai Mitchell and RB Breece Hall both inactive Sunday.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq (back) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (back) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a breakout performance in Week 3, but his momentum may be halted by an injury, as he is now questionable to play ahead of Sunday's game against the Bears. If he's ruled out, look for veteran Jeremy Ruckert to serve as the team's TE1 with Mason Taylor (thumb) already ruled out for the Jets.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (back) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Sadiq has logged back-to-back limited practices. He is on track to be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught three passes for 47 yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. racks up 47 yards Monday
news.impact: Pitts has had a very rough start to the season from a fantasy perspective, and it didn't get much better on Monday. He was able to rack up 47 yards at least, but he only caught three passes and failed to get into the end zone at all. He shouldn't be trusted as a starter for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught just one of two targets for five yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. snags single pass in win
news.impact: Pitts took a backseat to Drake London and Bijan Robinson in this game, with Michael Penix heavily favoring London in terms of target share. Pitts was productive last year both with London on and off the field, but Penix has been so fixated on London in his starts that it's tough to trust Pitts. He is a bit of a shaky fantasy start until his workload improves.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught one of three targets for 15 yards in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. snags one pass in win
news.impact: With the Falcons' QB play being so abysmal, it's hard to take anything away from the last two weeks. Hopefully we will see Michael Penix on Thursday to help bring some clarity and stability to the passing game.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. failed to catch his lone target in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. held without a catch in Week 1
news.impact: It was a rough day for the Atlanta passing attack as third-string QB Cooper Rush only passed for 143 yards. Pitts will hope to bounce back in Week 2 against the Panthers, although he will be tough to trust in fantasy as long as Rush is under center.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
news.head: Mark Andrews finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Andrews caught a three-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to extend the Ravens' lead. This marked the veteran's first trip to the end zone this season. Andrews will look to build on this performance against the Falcons in Week 5.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught three of his five targets for 24 yards in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
news.head: Mark Andrews goes for 24 yards in Week 3 win
news.impact: Andrews left the game in Brazil briefly with a hand injury but was able to return to action. The veteran tight end finished third on the Ravens in receiving in the contest. Andrews has now caught 13 passes for 122 yards through three games. He will be a high-end TE2 heading into Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 6-of-7 targets for 49 yards in the Ravens 24-17 loss to the Saints.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in six passes in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Andrews ranked second on the team in targets, receptions, and yardage in the loss Sunday. With Zay Flowers (hamstring) out, Andrews should continue to see an increase in targets behind Rashod Bateman. Andrews and the Ravens will take on the Cowboys in Week 3.

news.body: Mark Andrews hauled in four of his six targets for 49 yards in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Mark Andrews sees six targets in Week 1 win
news.impact: Andrews received sizeable volume in the Baltimore passing attack, finishing tied for first in targets in the win. The veteran tight end remains a reliable option ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches touchdown in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran had an pretty good game on Sunday. He finished with 40 yards and a touchdown against the Jaguars, although that wasn't enough to help the Bengals pick up a win at home. Gesicki may be a great fantasy option in Week 5 with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at serious risk of missing time.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Gesicki had a much needed bounce back performance after failing to record a target in Week 2. He tallied his second touchdown of the season on a 25-yard touchdown reception early in the fourth quarter. Gesicki will look to build on this performance in Week 4 against Jacksonville.

news.body: Mike Gesicki did not see a target in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Mike Gesicki not targeted Sunday
news.impact: Gesicki was coming off a big Week 1 performance. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 week-to-week.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 5-of-7 targets for 78 yards with a touchdown in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki explodes to open season
news.impact: While Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins were fairly quiet on Sunday, it was Gesicki who led the team in receiving. Despite his big Week 1 performance, he still isn't a reliable weekly start yet.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II caught 5-of-8 targets for 36 yards in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Gadsden was a safety blanket for Justin Herbert with his longest reception going for nine yards. He'll be a TE2 play next week against the Broncos.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II failed to catch any of his three targets in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II sees three targets in Week 3
news.impact: Gadsden II has been minimally involved in the Los Angeles passing attack early on, seeing three targets or less in each of the first three games. The tight end remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said TE Oronde Gadsden II is "ready to step up."
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II 'ready to step up' per HC Jim Harbaugh
news.impact: Gadsden will be stepping into a bigger role with both David Njoku and Charlie Kolar sidelined. He'll be a viable streamer for fantasy managers.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II caught two passes for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Gadsden didn't see a lot of opportunities on Sunday, but he was able to capitalize on one of them by scoring Los Angeles' lone touchdown through the air against the Raiders. He still didn't have a great fantasy total, but he may see an increase in work moving forward with David Njoku (knee) possibly needing to miss time.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 3-of-5 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth catches touchdown in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Freiermuth scored for the second time this season and the first time since Week 1 during Thursday's loss. The veteran TE has gotten at least four targets in each of the Steelers' first four games, but he's averaging just over 31 yards per game. Freiermuth should be viewed as a TD-dependent streamer at present.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-4 targets for 30 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth hauls in two passes in Week 3
news.impact: Freiermuth has yet to find consistent success this season, and has seen his production dip each week since the season opener. The 27-year-old veteran will continue to compete with Darnell Washington for targets as the Steelers take on the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth caught 4-of-5 targets for 32 yards and rushed once for two yards in the Steelers 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth hauls in four passes in Week 2
news.impact: Freiermuth has logged five targets in both games this season and appears to have built a rapport with Aaron Rodgers. With Michael Pittman dealing with an ankle injury, the veteran tight end could be a solid option heading into a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth finds the end zone in Week 1 win
news.impact: Freiermuth kicked off the season with a promising outing in the win over Atlanta. He hauled in Aaron Rodgers' lone touchdown pass on a six-yard catch in the second quarter while tying for second on the team in receptions. Freiermuth will settle in as a TE2 in fantasy heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Patriots.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 8-of-13 targets for 84 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta hits paydirt in Sunday's loss
news.impact: LaPorta put up new season highs in receptions and yards Sunday night, tying for the team lead with eight grabs. LaPorta also scored for the second time this season. He's not a sure thing every week, but LaPorta is a definite top-10 TE with top-five upside the rest of the way.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-4 targets for 44 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Sam LaPorta tallies three receptions in Week 3
news.impact: LaPorta saw the bulk of the targets go to Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs in the win over the Jets. Fantasy managers will hope that LaPorta can become more involved against the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: Sam LaPorta hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 52 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Sam LaPorta hauls in touchdown Thursday
news.impact: LaPorta had a good showing on Thursday night. He caught all but one of his targets and turned that into 52 yards and a touchdown in a shootout loss against the Buffalo Bills. He might struggle with consistency moving forward but will continue to have as high of a TD upside as anyone for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught five of his eight targets for 48 yards in the Lions' 31-30 Week 1 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Sam LaPorta catches five passes in Week 1 win
news.impact: LaPorta saw sizeable volume in his return to the lineup for head coach Dan Campbell, joining explosive wideouts Jameson Williams and Amon-Ra St. Brown in finishing with eight or more targets in the win. The tight end remains a stable option in all formats as a primary pass-catching option in the Detroit offense ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Rams placed TE Terrance Ferguson on injured reserve.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Ferguson went down with the injury last Sunday. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson will be sidelined as expected after leaving last Sunday's game early. Colby Parkinson will be questionable.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) did not take part in Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: It looks like the young tight end is trending towards being sidelined in Week 4, as he has been a non-participant at both of the team's practices to start the week. Tyler Higbee is primed to be the team's top tight end this week with Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) also unlikely to play on Sunday.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) misses practice
news.impact: Ferguson remains likely to be sidelined this week.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson hauled in all 13 of his targets for 119 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson dominant in win Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson stepped up for the Vikings on Sunday. He was by far the team's leader in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in Week 4, though he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a worthwhile fantasy asset for however long Justin Jefferson (ankle) remains sidelined for the Vikings.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 2-of-4 targets for 11 yards receiving in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson quiet Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson was uninvolved despite Justin Jefferson (ankle) exiting early. He could be in the streaming conversation next week against the Dolphins if Jefferson is sidelined.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught three of his four targets for 29 yards in the Vikings' 9-3 Week 2 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson catches three passes in Week 2 win
news.impact: Hockenson has made the most of modest involvement in the Minnesota passing attack to begin the season, recording three of more receptions in each of the first two games. The tight end remains one of the more risky pass-catching options for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 3 contest against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 36 yards in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson caught one of the three touchdowns thrown by Carson Wentz. He could be on the TE1 radar in a favorable matchup next week against the Bears.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 4 win
news.impact: Kelce was quiet in the win as Tyquan Thornton and Xavier Worthy did most of the damage in the passing attack. Kelce has been a solid fantasy tight end this season, catching 16 passes for 246 yards and two touchdowns in four games. He will be on bye in Week 5 before taking on the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 59 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Travis Kelce finds end zone in Week 3 win over Dolphins
news.impact: Kelce has been impactful to begin the season, recording over 55 receiving yards in each of the first three contests. The veteran tight end has turned back the clock as part of a revamped Chiefs offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Travis Kelce hauled in 9-of-11 targets for 101 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Travis Kelce dominant in overtime win Sunday
news.impact: Kelce looked great on Sunday night. He led the team in receptions and racked up 101 receiving yards on the night, a number which he failed to hit at all last season. His touchdown was the cherry on top for fantasy managers, and he will likely continue to have good week-to-week value if Patrick Mahomes and KC's offense continues to look this good moving forward.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught 3-of-5 targets for 71 yards in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Travis Kelce solid in win Monday
news.impact: Kelce wasn't very involved for much of Monday night's game, but he was able to haul in a big catch at one point that helped to leave him with a solid 71 yards on the night. Fantasy managers should be pleased with his performance in this matchup but should not expect him to be a TE1 on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, especially with Kansas City seemingly wanting to operate as a run-heavy team this season.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-12 targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride saw plenty of opportunities on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them. His seven passes turned into just 31 yards, so if someone started him in a non-PPR league format, his fantasy finish was quite disappointing for them. He should bounce back and return to form sometime within the next week or two, however.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 9-of-11 targets for 75 yards in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in nine passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride continues to be the safety blanket for Jacoby Brissett all over the field every week. He and Brock Bowers remain 1A and 1B among the tight end position.

news.body: Trey McBride caught eight of 10 targets for 41 yards and a score in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
news.head: Trey McBride snags touchdown in loss to Seattle
news.impact: McBride was the only thing working for the offense on Sunday, and even that only lasted but for so long. Seattle completely shut down the Cardinals in the second half, and McBride with them. But, it's doubtful any fantasy manager will complain about eight catches for 40+ yards and a score from their tight end.

news.body: Trey McBride (rest/back) did not take part in Arizona's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Trey McBride (rest/back) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Arizona gave their star tight end the day off on Wednesday as a rest day. He was also listed with a back issue of some kind, but it seems to be nothing serious and isn't likely to play a factor on his availability for Week 2. He will remain a top-tier fantasy asset every time he's healthy and on the field for the Cardinals.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught six of his seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown while adding a three-yard run in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Kraft scored his first touchdown of the season on a two-yard pass from Jordan Love. The veteran tight end set a season-high in receptions in the game as he continues to ramp up after last season's ACL tear. Overall, Kraft has 15 catches for 148 yards and one touchdown. He will be a TE1 in fantasy in Week 5 against the Bears.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to Atlanta on Thursday.
news.head: Tucker Kraft snags four passes in loss to Atlanta
news.impact: Kraft could have had a slightly bigger day had he held onto the football in what ended up being ruled a drop. The defensive back made a fantastic punch at the ball right as Kraft was corralling it into his chest, forcing a dropped pass. Kraft is still worth starting, and with that eight-target total, he has now beaten his season high in targets (previously six). The volume is there; the results just haven't quite followed yet.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught two of his three targets for 15 yards in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
news.head: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 2 win
news.impact: Kraft was unable to make a significant impact as part of an underwhelming Green Bay passing attack, finishing with less than four receptions in each of the first two games. The tight end will look to get back on track for fantasy managers against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 3.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught 3-of-6 targets for 65 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Tucker Kraft totals 65 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kraft was playing in his first game back from his torn ACL. He was on a snap count in his first game back. He remains a TE1 heading into next week against the Jets.

news.body: Tyler Higbee hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Tyler Higbee solid in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end stepped up and played a bigger role again in Week 4. He did well with his opportunities, finishing with five catches for 67 yards in a win over the Eagles. He should continue to be a viable fantasy option with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) set to be sidelined for a few more weeks at least.

news.body: Tyler Higbee hauled in 8-of-11 targets for 62 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Tyler Higbee stellar in win Sunday
news.impact: Higbee stepped up on Sunday night with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) injured for most of the game. The veteran finished with eight catches for 62 yards against the Broncos and was able to get into the end zone on one of those catches. He could have decent streaming value next week depending on the injury status of Ferguson and Puka Nacua (hip) in Week 4.

news.body: The Rams signed TE Tyler Higbee to a new two-year contract.
news.head: Tyler Higbee signs new two-year deal with Rams
news.impact: The deal is worth $11 million as Higbee returns to the Rams for an 11th season. He'll continue to play a big part of the 13 personnel the Rams run, though his fantasy upside will remain limited

news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay said that Rams TE Tyler Higbee is still deciding on his future.
news.head: Tyler Higbee still deciding on future
news.impact: McVay added that the team is interested in re-signing Higbee if he decides to play another season. They'll be looking to add another tight end this offseason as they likely continue to lead the NFL in 13 personnel.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught 5-of-5 targets for 41 yards in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders.
news.head: Tyler Warren hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
news.impact: Warren and the rest of the Colts' pass catchers had a relatively quiet day as the team focused on the ground game. His five targets tie a season low, and Warren will look to become more involved in Week 5 against the Steelers.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught 9-of-10 targets for 55 yards in a 19-17 win over the Texans.
news.head: Tyler Warren hauls in nine passes in Week 3 win
news.impact: Warren set a new career high in receptions Sunday and continues to see plenty of opportunities in the Colts' offense this season. Fantasy managers should expect Warren to continue to see plenty of targets against Washington with Alec Pierce (heel) out.

news.body: Tyler Warren hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 21 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Tyler Warren hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The young tight end had an up-and-down night on Sunday. On one hand, he finished with a touchdown and six catches on the night, which led to good results in PPR leagues. On the other hand, he only totaled 21 yards on his seven targets, which is poor as far as efficiency goes. Fantasy managers should continue to expect high volume from him moving forward, especially with Alec Pierce (heel) seemingly set to miss some time.

news.body: Tyler Warren hauled in three of his five targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in a 41-23 Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Tyler Warren finds end zone in Week 1 loss
news.impact: Warren was mostly bottled up by a stiff Baltimore defense, averaging 4.3 yards per reception in the Week 1 loss. The tight end remains a primary pass-catching offense for head coach Shane Steichen ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to miss at least six weeks for the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) out at least six weeks
news.impact: Brown was placed on injured reserve after suffering the ankle injury in New England’s Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks Wednesday night, leaving head coach Mike Vrable without his top pass-catching option for the foreseeable future. In the wideout’s absence Mack Hollins, Romeo Doubs, and DeMario Douglas will need to step up for quarterback Drake Maye early in the season.

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) has been placed on injured reserve by the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) placed on injured reserve

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to miss at least four weeks with a high ankle sprain that he sustained early in the third quarter of the Patriots game against the Seahawks on Wednesday night.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) expect to miss at least four weeks
news.impact: It’s a big blow to Brown’s Fantasy stock to start the season. In his absence, expect Hunter Henry and Romeo Doubs to see more work. However, with Doubs was struggling to find snaps and catch the ball, it’s possible that Demario Douglas could be a nice PPR sleeper.

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in last nights game against the Seahawks. He will have an MRI today to determine the extent of the injury and how much time he will miss.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) believed to have suffered high-ankle sprain on Wednesday
news.impact: It’s a tough start to Browns Patriot tenure. He went down early in the third quarter and did not return, leaving Drake Maye to lean on Hunter Henry, Demario Douglas, and Mack Hollins with fellow newcomer Romeo Doubs struggling to catch anything. Doubs should bounce back, and if Brown is out for any period of time, expect Doubs and Henry to have some more fantasy appeal, with Douglas as a PPR dart throw in deep formats.

news.body: Amon Ra St. Brown came up with 8-of-11 targets for 75 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown makes eight grabs in Week 4 loss
news.impact: St. Brown failed to make it four straight games with a touchdown to start the season, but he still produced a solid showing. St. Brown has largely delivered for fantasy managers over the first quarter of the season, averaging nearly eight receptions for more than 75 yards with five scores to this point. He remains a certain WR1.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 4-of-8 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown finds the end zone in Week 3 win
news.impact: St. Brown was not able to capitalize on his eight targets, but was able to help salvage the day with a touchdown in the second quarter. St. Brown now has five touchdowns through the first three games of the season and will look to build on a strong start to the season against the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 6-of-8 targets for 142 yards and two touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown scores twice in loss Thursday
news.impact: St. Brown was on fire on Thursday night. He had a slow start, but he ended up finishing the game with a team high in receptions and receiving yards while finding the end zone twice against the Bills. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, especially in PPR scoring formats.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in 10 of his team-leading 14 targets for 67 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' 31-30 Week 1 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauls in 10 receptions in Week 1 win over Saints
news.impact: St. Brown was dynamic in the season-opening contest for head coach Dan Campbell, hauling in both of quarterback Jared Goff's touchdown passes in the win. The wideout remains an elite WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 2 road matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
news.head: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Williams was second on the team in targets, just one behind Stefon Diggs. Williams could continue to see more playing time next week if Terry McLaurin does not return from his hamstring injury.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Commanders’ 33-31 Week 3 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Williams has fallen back to earth after an impressive showing in Week 1, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two games. The wideout remains a risky-pass catching option in an inconsistent offense early on, with a Week 4 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught all three of his targets for 24 yards in the Commanders loss to the Cowboys.
news.head: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 2
news.impact: Williams saw his production dip from a strong Week 1 performance. The rookie wide receiver figures to lose some fantasy value with Jayden Daniels sidelined with an elbow injury. Williams and the Commanders will take on the Seahawks in Week 3.

news.body: Antonio Williams hauled in each of his four targets for 64 yards and one touchdown in the Commanders’ 24-22 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 1.
news.head: Antonio Williams leads pass-catchers in Week 1 loss to Eagles
news.impact: Williams impressed in his regular season debut, leading the team in receptions, receiving yards, and yards per reception in a losing effort. The rookie pass-catcher will look to replicate his performance as part of a crowded wide receiver room alongside Stefon Diggs and Terry McLaurin against the Dallas Cowboys in Week 2.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught two passes for 17 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Thomas was able to haul in Jacksonville's lone passing touchdown against the Bengals. He wasn't able to do much outside of that, however, totaling just 17 yards over the course of the afternoon. He has had a slow start to the season and should not be considered a viable fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught one pass for eight yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. quiet in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Thomas was a complete non-factor on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the afternoon, and he was only able to turn that into eight yards on a day that Jacksonville's offense had no trouble scoring and moving the ball. He still has some potential given his talent, but he hasn't been productive for a while and shouldn't be started for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) off injury report for Week 3
news.impact: Thomas is now off of the injury report and should be a full go heading into a Week 3 matchup against the New England Patriots. He isn't expected to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught three of his eight targets for 40 yards in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. goes for 40 yards in Week 2
news.impact: Thomas seemed healthy after dealing with a shoulder injury in Week 1. He wound up finishing second on the Jags in all receiving categories while drawing an encouraging eight targets. Thomas is clearly behind Parker Washington in the pecking order, but he appears to be ahead of Jakobi Meyers, making him a solid WR3 in fantasy moving forward. He will face the Patriots in Week 3.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught 9-of-12 targets for 145 yards in the Titans loss to the Ravens Sunday .
news.head: Carnell Tate eclipses 100 receiving yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Tate did fumble the ball twice, losing one after an impressive reception. He set new season highs in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss. Tate and the Titans will look for their first win of the season as they take on Houston in Week 5.

news.body: Carnell Tate hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 12-7 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Carnell Tate leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was arguably the lone bright spot for the Titans on Sunday. He led the team with 58 receiving yards on the afternoon and flashed some real talent in the process. He's a good player but isn't likely to be a consistent fantasy producer on this offense, which is among the NFL's worst.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught three of his five targets for 27 yards in a 24-20 loss to the Eagles in Week 2.
news.head: Carnell Tate catches three passes in Week 2
news.impact: Tate finished fourth on the team in receiving yards in the close loss to Philly. The rookie has caught seven of his 11 targets for 65 scoreless yards through the first two games of the season. Tennessee will now get ready to take on the Giants in Week 3. Tate will be tough to start in fantasy until Tennessee's passing attack starts to show more life.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught four of his six targets for 38 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.head: Carnell Tate catches four passes in Week 1
news.impact: Tate tied for the team lead in targets and receiving yards while finishing second in receptions in his NFL debut. The rookie receiver will surely have bigger games going forward, as the entire Tennessee offense struggled in the season opener. Tate will be a low-end WR3 heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) practices in full Tuesday
news.impact: Lamb remains a locked and loaded WR1 for Thursday’s game against the Buccaneers.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) logs full practice Monday
news.impact: Lamb will remain a locked and loaded WR1 for Thursday’s game against the Buccaneers.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught 17-of-21 targets for 189 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in 17 passes Sunday
news.impact: Lamb had the go-ahead touchdown with less than 30 seconds left in the game. It was a career day for him getting targeted all throughout the second half. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught seven of his eight targets for 112 yards and caught a two-point conversion in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
